name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest merged PR first. This gives us a clean baseline to measure its impact without disrupting active work. The trade-off is delayed visibility into open PRs, but we avoid noise in the review queue while validating accuracy. Once the merged PR confirms no false positives, we expand to open PRs.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on merged PRs trains reviewers to ignore real issues because the model’s feedback arrives after the fact—when fixes are already merged. Better: run PR-Agent in shadow mode on open PRs first; this catches edge cases before they’re buried in history. Settle it by comparing false negative rates between open and merged PRs over two weeks.
